display.purpose: The person's name in the home hero only.

headline.purpose: h1 inside a charcoal page sign or station sign; 3rem below 768px, 4.5rem above.

section.purpose: Home section headings under a 4px charcoal rule; 1.875rem below 768px, 2.25rem above.

title.purpose: Role titles, result values, skill-group names, station-detail subheads (1.25rem to 1.5rem).

body.purpose: Running copy capped at 60-70ch; lead copy at 1.125rem.

label.purpose: Nav, buttons (1rem at default size), arrow links, legend, availability items.

station-name.purpose: Station names on the line map, on or near a plate.

timetable.purpose: Years, periods and date ranges only (0.75rem to 0.875rem).

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Easing for the line draw-in and station pop.

motion.name: draw-x / draw-y
motion.purpose: Each track half draws in once on load (horizontal from 768px, vertical below); motion-safe only.

motion.name: stop
motion.value: 420ms ease-out-expo, opacity 0 and scale 0.4 to rest
motion.purpose: Station markers pop in as the track reaches them; motion-safe only.

motion.name: station-step
motion.purpose: Stagger per station; the end half of a station starts 55ms after its start half.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: All hover and active states are colour transitions; nothing moves or lifts.

patterns.name: track-planned
patterns.purpose: Dashed planned track toward the terminus; the only patterned fill in the system.

narrative.overview:
The site reads like a metro platform: a white floor, charcoal enamel sign bands carrying white Overpass, and a route diagram that does the storytelling. The career is one line with two parallel tracks, frontend in line blue and backend in line red, and every role is a station on it. Full-stack roles are interchanges (a capsule where both tracks stop); frontend-only roles let the red track run straight through. The rest of the system exists to stay out of the diagram's way.

Density is low and confident. Each view has one word set big enough to win (the name, the station name, the page sign) and one calm stone panel that carries the facts and the actions. Everything is flat: no shadows, no gradients, no card stacks. Hierarchy comes from scale, weight 900 against 400, heavy charcoal rules, and the switch between white platform and charcoal sign. The rejected alternative is the dark developer hero with a gradient name and a cloud of coloured skill pills.
keyCharacteristics: White platform ground with full-bleed charcoal sign bands (header, page signs, contact terminus, footer).
Two territory colours only, blue and red, always meaning frontend and backend.
Yellow is the platform edge: rare, reserved for "you are here" and focus on dark.
Square corners everywhere except route-diagram marks, which are round.
Overpass Black for every heading; Overpass Mono only for dates.
Motion is the line drawing itself once on load, then plain colour transitions.

rules.name: The Territory Rule
rules.body: Blue and red fill only territory marks: tracks, track bullets, legend swatches, track bars. They never fill a button, a panel, a heading or a status. If a mark is not about frontend or backend, it is charcoal.

rules.name: The Platform Edge Rule
rules.body: Yellow marks where you are or where the eye must land on charcoal: active nav, focus on dark, selection, skip link, current stop, terminus plate. It is never a call-to-action fill. Primary actions are charcoal on white and white on charcoal.

rules.name: The Timetable Rule
rules.body: Overpass Mono sets dates, years and periods only. Codes, labels, tags and buttons stay in Overpass.

rules.name: The Signage Weight Rule
rules.body: Every heading is Black (900) with tight tracking (-0.025em, down to -0.035em at display size). Body never goes bold for emphasis inside paragraphs; emphasis is a label or a plate.

rules.name: The Enamel Rule
rules.body: Dark surfaces are full-bleed sign bands, not floating dark cards. Stacked bands are separated by a Sign Dim hairline at 25-30% alpha.

dos: Do keep blue and red for frontend and backend marks only, and show both together whenever a role is full-stack.
Do put the primary action in charcoal on white and white on charcoal; secondary actions outline the same colour.
Do open every internal page with a full-bleed charcoal sign band and a headline-size Black h1.
Do keep corners at 0; reserve round forms for stations, interchanges, track bullets and the roundel.
Do set dates, years and periods in Overpass Mono, and nothing else.
Do gate the draw-in and stop animations behind motion-safe; everything else is a colour transition.
donts: Don't use yellow as a button or CTA fill.
Don't add shadows, gradients or glows; the dashed planned track is the only patterned fill.
Don't round buttons, panels, plates, tags or image frames.
Don't colour skill tags or stack lists by territory, or build a pill cloud.
Don't place a label, kicker or eyebrow above a section heading; the charcoal rule is the opener.
Don't float a dark card on the white platform; dark means a full-bleed sign band.
